title: Authoritative Swarm Thread DAG Lifecycle & Session State Keying
author: deep-repo-auditor

claims.assertion: AgentExecutionGraphService keys swarm wave nodes using the composite key f'{run_id}_{node_id}' to prevent cross-run collisions during concurrent agent executions.
AgentSessionManager strictly enforces task as primary argument for creation, final_answer for completion, and error_message for failure.
Swarm wave lifecycles track states (Open, Closed, Completed, Failed) along directional spawn edges with automated hierarchical token rollups.
